caption: The drawing depicts seven square swatches of patterned fabric, arranged in two horizontal rows, three squares in the top row and four in the bottom. Each fabric swatch is distinct in its color and design. The top left swatch is red with a pattern of large, green and yellow stylized flowers and small yellow elements. The center swatch in the top row is pink, featuring light floral patterns with yellow, red, and white accents. The top right swatch is a pale green shade with a design of red and dark green flower motifs along with smaller leaf patterns. In the bottom row, the leftmost swatch is a pale yellow background with a small, multicolored floral pattern in blue, red, and green. The second swatch from the left in the bottom row is a multi-colored design, featuring vertical bands in green, red, blue, and black, each with their own patterns and bordered by white lines. The third swatch from the left in the bottom row displays a brown background with blue, red, and pink large flowers and green leaves in a scattered arrangement. The rightmost swatch in the bottom row is red, decorated with a regular pattern of small, dark circular motifs. The swatches are painted on a light, off-white background, and the artist’s signature, “Henry Grasset,” is visible at the bottom left of the drawing.
title: Patchwork Quilt (Swatches)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
